selection: Among development-utility-feasible presets, minimize mean merged development accuracy; ties prefer lower strength, then config order. If none is feasible, do not run final tests.
calibration: Unlabelled MNIST training subset; all tokens, centered PCA. SVHN training subset is diagnostic only and never used to construct the random perturbation.
development: Disjoint training subsets with labels; not held out from the original expert training. No official test samples for fitting or selection.
attack: Independent MNIST training subset, no labels; attacker recomputes PCA from the released model. Public location and retained-energy rule, no defender basis, random matrix or original expert.
training: none; no optimizer, gradient update or fitted replacement network
protection: Single-layer input-complement random perturbation with mean bias compensation; no permutation, rotation or rank truncation.
